chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام gave judgment concerning two men: one of them held [the victim], and the other killed [him]. He said: The killer is to be killed, and the other is to be imprisoned until he dies of grief, just as he had restrained him until he died of grief.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام as the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.قَضَى: gave judgment or issued a legal ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling when one person restrains a victim and another person kills him?
ai.summary: This hadith records a judicial ruling of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding joint participation in murder through direct killing and restraint. It distinguishes between the one who committed the killing and the one who enabled it by holding the victim, assigning a specific punishment to each according to his role.
